data.name: Questwood
data.detailed_description:
Fight, loot, and explore procedurally generated forests. Play in singleplayer or with friends in local split-screen co-op mode! Choose from four distinct classes, Archer, Bomber, Spartan, and Wizard. Uncover powerful weapons with unique abilities, and build the ultimate deck of modifier cards. Can you survive the forest and defeat the Cursed Tree?

Archer, Bomber, Spartan, or Wizard - pick your playstyle!

Each class comes with unique items and abilities. Fire arrows and swing across gaps with the Archer’s grappling hook. Cause chaos with the Bomber’s explosive arsenal. Dominate melee combat as the Spartan. Or harness powerful spells as the Wizard. Combine classes in local split-screen co-op and find broken synergies. In co-op, each player gets their own loot. Be aware though, when more players join the forest, the difficulty increases!

A new adventure every time you play

With procedurally generated levels full of unique challenges and rewards, every run features new loot and surprises. The game has permadeath, so be careful. You keep the cards you collect along the way. Build the best deck or go wild and create something crazy for fun, like a deck full of pet rock cards. At the end of each level, a mini-boss awaits. There are 10 levels in one run. After those, there is an 11th level with a final boss. If you can defeat the Cursed Tree, you can continue in infinite mode to chase the high score!

data.short_description: Fight your way through the forest in this action roguelite! Play as the Archer, Bomber, Spartan, or Wizard. Discover class-specific weapons, and craft the best combination of 3 modifier cards. Can you survive the forest and defeat the Cursed Tree?
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Dutch, Spanish - Spain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 64-bit quad-core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
